title.zh: ZachXBT披露调查细节：自掏腰包渗透洗钱网络换取情报，协助冻结Bybit被盗资金
title.en: ZachXBT披露调查细节：自掏腰包渗透洗钱网络换取情报，协助冻结Bybit被盗资金

current_state.zh: ZachXBT disclosed that he went undercover as a client to infiltrate a Chinese organized-crime money-laundering network tied to Lazarus Group, using the intelligence to help freeze and attribute funds from the February 2025 Bybit hack and other exploits.
